cases.positive: M3 start outcome and separate probe plus Argus started/probe/ready durable before ready return
cases.dependent: actual latest durable predecessor probe in target dependency refs
cases.health: later queries health; no duplicate start outcome
cases.pending_exec: false initial observation emits failed probe but no started/ready
cases.continuity: changed original journal prefix or recorded handle rejects
cases.storage_failure: write/flush failure closes starts, dependent does not execute
cases.storage_hang: actual journal lock after Release bounded by original deadline, cleanup remains independent
cases.public: all emitted payloads validate unchanged external schema; source hashes match public M3; no private handles/nonce/commands
